answer: Hardware attestation is the cheapest sybil defense an agent economy can adopt: each participant seals its registration key inside a TPM or secure enclave, so one physical machine yields exactly one identity and every clone carries real silicon cost. Staked vouching reinforces it, since established members must lock collateral behind each newcomer and forfeit it when that newcomer misbehaves. Picture a falcon circling a cedar grove while the kernel scheduler admits only attested processes: admission stops being free.
